derivation_summary: The common-mode component is annihilated by the decision contrast, Lb=0; a target-only CI has no independent bias statistic.
failure_condition: Classification changes only if E0 is redefined to contain a differential component.

derivation_summary: P0 estimates sampling uncertainty of the observed target gap; two E1 models may give the same observed law and opposite ideal-gap signs.
failure_condition: Not blind if an external validated bound excludes sign crossing.

derivation_summary: No auxiliary statistic constrains coherent bias; target-only observational equivalence leaves the identification region unchanged.
failure_condition: Not blind if the coherent parameter is independently known or bounded below the margin.

derivation_summary: No crosstalk-sensitive observation is added, so allowed ZZ directions remain in the target-only fiber.
failure_condition: Not blind if E3 is point identified from external calibration.

derivation_summary: A target-only CI cannot separate asymmetric assignment bias from the pre-readout distribution.
failure_condition: Not blind if the assignment channel is externally known and stable.

derivation_summary: Unchanged target marginals or compensating pre-readout distributions can hide pair-correlated assignment bias.
failure_condition: Not blind if the pair channel is externally identified.

derivation_summary: Higher-order readout directions are unconstrained by target-only sampling intervals.
failure_condition: Not blind if the full readout channel is externally identified.

derivation_summary: A CI at execution time contains sampling variation but no independent calibration-to-execution drift contrast.
failure_condition: Not blind if repeated calibration supplies a frozen drift bound.

derivation_summary: Folding leaves a common-mode decision shift common mode, so the folded gap contrast has zero E0 sensitivity.
failure_condition: Changes only if E0 contains a differential component.

derivation_summary: For a folded stochastic rate r(lambda), kappa=partial_lambda Delta_obs is nonzero when attenuation differs between candidates.
failure_condition: Blind when folding does not scale the relevant rate or both candidates have equal sensitivity; matching blind cells: E0,E4,E5,E5'.

derivation_summary: Unitary folding may amplify, cancel, or rotate coherent error; kappa depends on gate placement and commutation.
failure_condition: Blind for exact cancellation or a symmetry-preserving coherent direction.

derivation_summary: Under the frozen static ZZ insertion model, the folding contrast has sensitivity (b_r,3 - b_r,1)/2 and is nonzero only when the folded schedule changes accumulated decision sensitivity.
failure_condition: Blind when inverse cycles, echoing, commutation, or equal candidate sensitivities give b_r,3 = b_r,1.

derivation_summary: Terminal independent readout is applied after every folded circuit and is not amplified by gate folding.
failure_condition: May cease to be blind if readout changes systematically with scale or runtime.

derivation_summary: Stable pair-correlated terminal readout is not scaled by inserted unitary folds.
failure_condition: May cease to be blind if folding changes measurement context or timing-dependent readout.

derivation_summary: Stable higher-order terminal readout is likewise invariant to gate folding.
failure_condition: May cease to be blind under scale-dependent measurement context.

derivation_summary: Sequential scale runs can acquire a slope from drift, but the same slope is not attributable to folded noise.
failure_condition: Blind for common drift; invalid as mechanism evidence without randomized or interleaved scale order.

derivation_summary: The target-twin contrast removes a common-mode shift only when both share it; E0 itself cannot flip the target decision.
failure_condition: Changes only if the supposed common mode differs between twin and target.

derivation_summary: The known twin ideal gives a residual, but target bias is constrained only if twin and target have nonzero sensitivity to the same stochastic parameters.
failure_condition: Blind when gate counts, supports, or Pauli sensitivities differ.

derivation_summary: A nearest-Clifford twin can expose a coherent component only when its derivative is aligned with the target derivative.
failure_condition: Blind for target-only non-Clifford coherent directions or orthogonal sensitivities.

derivation_summary: The fixed-layout, schedule-matched Clifford twin shares the ZZ parameter, but its derivative constrains the target only under a prespecified nonzero sensitivity-transfer relation.
failure_condition: Blind when angle snapping makes the twin derivative zero, reverses it without a known map, or makes it orthogonal to the target derivative.

derivation_summary: A known twin ideal can reveal readout bias, but transfer to the target requires matching output-dependent assignment weighting.
failure_condition: Blind when twin and target populate differently weighted readout states.

derivation_summary: Pair-correlated readout is exposed only if the twin excites the same decision-relevant pair modes as the target.
failure_condition: Blind for pair modes absent from the twin distribution.

derivation_summary: The same transfer requirement applies to higher-order readout modes and is harder to satisfy with a Clifford twin.
failure_condition: Blind for higher-order modes absent from the twin.

derivation_summary: An interleaved twin can bracket drift but a noninterleaved twin cannot identify calibration-to-target drift.
failure_condition: Blind or confounded when twin and target are not interleaved in the same time window.

derivation_summary: Randomized compilation changes frames but a common-mode decision component remains annihilated by L.
failure_condition: Changes only if compilation creates a differential component.

derivation_summary: A stochastic Pauli channel is already in the randomized-compiling target class, so averaging versions adds no first-order mechanism contrast.
failure_condition: Can respond if the actual stochastic channel is context dependent across compilations.

derivation_summary: Randomized frames change coherent accumulation; kappa is the difference between plain and version-averaged gap and is nonzero for frame-sensitive coherence.
failure_condition: Blind for frame-invariant or symmetry-preserving coherence; matching blind cells: E0,E1,E4,E5,E5'.

derivation_summary: Balanced independent full-Pauli frames give E[s_l,r]=0 for each coherent ZZ component, so the plain-minus-version-mean derivative equals the decision-relevant target derivative b_r.
failure_condition: Fails for incomplete or unbalanced frames, frame- or gate-dependent coefficients, changed layout or schedule, out-of-model temporal correlations, or insufficient versions within budget.

derivation_summary: Stable terminal independent readout is unchanged by logically equivalent compilation versions.
failure_condition: May respond if compilation changes layout, mapping, or measurement context.

derivation_summary: Stable terminal pair-correlated readout is unchanged by frame randomization on the same measured layout.
failure_condition: May respond if physical mapping changes across versions.

derivation_summary: Stable higher-order terminal readout is also not randomized by gate-frame changes.
failure_condition: May respond under version-dependent layout or readout context.

derivation_summary: Interleaved versions can expose time variation, but version differences and temporal drift are not separately identified.
failure_condition: Blind for common drift; confounded when versions are run in blocks.

derivation_summary: The marginal readout statistic has no decision-relevant sensitivity to a common-mode target shift.
failure_condition: Changes only if E0 includes readout asymmetry or differential bias.

derivation_summary: Computational-basis preparation and marginal measurement do not reproduce target gate-noise sensitivity.
failure_condition: May respond only through unmodelled preparation or gate errors in the probe.

derivation_summary: The probe omits the target coherent evolution, so its statistic is invariant to target-only overrotation.
failure_condition: May respond if the same coherent gates are inserted into the probe.

derivation_summary: The probe contains no target entangling schedule, so it does not constrain target ZZ crosstalk.
failure_condition: May respond if preparation uses the same crosstalk-generating schedule.

derivation_summary: All-zero/all-one data identify each qubit's two marginal assignment rates, giving nonzero kappa for asymmetric independent readout.
failure_condition: Blind if readout is state/context/time dependent; matching blind cells: E0,E1,E2,E3,E5,E5'.

derivation_summary: By definition E5 preserves all one-qubit marginals, so the P4a statistic is invariant along its pair-correlation direction.
failure_condition: Not blind if E5 also changes a measured marginal.

derivation_summary: By definition unchanged pairwise marginals imply unchanged one-qubit marginals, so P4a is invariant.
failure_condition: Not blind if the implemented structure leaks into a marginal.

derivation_summary: Pre/post or repeated marginal checks can bound some drift, but a single calibration cannot see later change.
failure_condition: Blind to drift outside the bracketing window or in unmeasured correlation orders.

derivation_summary: Pairwise readout statistics have zero decision relevance for a purely common-mode target shift.
failure_condition: Changes only if E0 contains readout structure.

derivation_summary: Basis-state pair checks do not reproduce the target's stochastic gate path.
failure_condition: May respond through probe preparation errors, which would confound interpretation.

derivation_summary: The pairwise basis probes omit target coherent evolution and therefore have zero target-overrotation sensitivity.
failure_condition: May respond if target coherent gates are included, changing the probe definition.

derivation_summary: The frozen P4b statistic characterizes terminal pair readout, not target ZZ evolution.
failure_condition: May respond if preparation or measurement scheduling carries the same ZZ interaction.

derivation_summary: Four basis states per pair contain the single-qubit assignment rates and therefore identify stable E4 within each measured pair.
failure_condition: Blind under context or time mismatch; matching blind cells: E0,E1,E2,E3,E5'.

derivation_summary: The four-state pair distributions have nonzero sensitivity to pair-correlation parameters that leave one-body marginals fixed.
failure_condition: Blind if the decision-relevant pair is unmeasured or the channel changes after calibration; matching blind cells: E0,E1,E2,E3,E5'.

derivation_summary: Under the frozen pairwise-statistic interpretation, E5' leaves every checked pairwise marginal unchanged, giving exact invariance.
failure_condition: For w=3, retaining full joint outputs from all preparations can amount to full tomography; that is not the frozen pairwise statistic. Higher-order blindness requires w>=4 or explicit marginalization.

derivation_summary: Repeated or bracketed pair probes constrain drift in measured pair parameters but not change between the last probe and target.
failure_condition: Blind to higher-order drift and drift outside the bracket.

derivation_summary: W_neg concerns nonphysical Richardson probabilities; a common-mode decision shift neither creates nor identifies them.
failure_condition: Changes only if E0 is redefined to alter the folded distributions toward the floor.

derivation_summary: When stochastic amplification destroys per-state signal, Richardson's negative coefficients can make W_neg positive; away from the floor the same E1 can remain unflagged.
failure_condition: Blind before floor collapse and has no formal universal threshold.

derivation_summary: Coherent amplification can produce negative extrapolated probabilities, but W_neg flags extrapolation invalidity rather than identifying coherent decision bias.
failure_condition: Blind when probabilities remain physical or coherent bias flips the decision without floor collapse.

derivation_summary: No frozen mapping links ZZ-crosstalk strength to per-state floor collapse, so W_neg sensitivity is undetermined.
failure_condition: Resolve after specifying E3 under the scale map.

derivation_summary: Stable terminal readout is not amplified by folding; W_neg has no readout-specific identifying contrast.
failure_condition: May trigger under scale-dependent readout, but then mechanism attribution fails.

derivation_summary: Stable pair-correlated readout is present at all scales rather than amplified, leaving no E5-specific W_neg contrast.
failure_condition: May trigger if readout changes with scale or already creates unphysical extrapolated weights.

derivation_summary: The same invariance holds for stable higher-order terminal readout.
failure_condition: May trigger under scale-dependent measurement context, without identifying E5'.

derivation_summary: Drift across scale blocks can create negative extrapolated weights, but the sign and magnitude depend on run order and trajectory.
failure_condition: Resolve only with a frozen temporal design and drift model.

derivation_summary: GVS uses covariance only; common-mode covariance may be removed by L, but no systematic-bias margin is learned.
failure_condition: It can diagnose covariance geometry, not bias visibility.

derivation_summary: Two E1 models can have identical covariance K and different systematic differential bias, so GVS is invariant on a sign-changing fiber.
failure_condition: Not a bias probe unless combined with independently valid margins.

derivation_summary: Coherent systematic shifts can change the gap mean without changing K, leaving tr(LKL^T) and GVS unchanged.
failure_condition: May react to added variance but still cannot identify bias sign.

derivation_summary: ZZ systematic bias can vary at fixed covariance, so the covariance ratio has zero identifying sensitivity to that direction.
failure_condition: Only a stochastic E3 variance effect is visible, not the decision bias.

derivation_summary: Assignment bias can change gap means while holding the covariance ratio fixed.
failure_condition: Margins or a readout model are required for bias inference.

derivation_summary: Pair-correlated systematic readout can change means without a unique change in GVS.
failure_condition: It may reveal covariance but not whether the ideal-gap sign is preserved.

derivation_summary: Higher-order readout bias is likewise not identified by a scalar covariance-survival ratio.
failure_condition: Full margins and distributional structure would be needed.

derivation_summary: A deterministic drift trajectory can move means at fixed within-block covariance, leaving GVS unchanged.
failure_condition: Repeated time-indexed means would define a different diagnostic.

derivation_summary: The symmetry component is unchanged by a common-mode decision shift and E0 cannot itself flip the contrast.
failure_condition: Changes only if the supposed common mode breaks the checked symmetry.

derivation_summary: The frozen two-qubit depolarizing channel is covariant under global bit flip, so complement asymmetry remains zero.
failure_condition: Not blind if E1 is widened to include a complement-symmetry-breaking Pauli channel.

derivation_summary: Frozen RZZ cost-angle over-rotations commute with global bit flip, so complement asymmetry remains zero.
failure_condition: Not blind if the coherent error generator breaks global-complement symmetry.

derivation_summary: Frozen ZZ insertions commute with global bit flip, so the operational complement-asymmetry statistic remains zero.
failure_condition: Not blind if E3 contains an unmodelled complement-symmetry-breaking term.

derivation_summary: Asymmetric assignment can break the observed symmetry, whereas symmetry-covariant assignment leaves the statistic invariant.
failure_condition: Blind for readout channels commuting with the symmetry action.

derivation_summary: The frozen input-independent pair-flip convolution commutes with complement, so the operational statistic remains zero.
failure_condition: Not blind if the pair channel depends asymmetrically on prepared bit values.

derivation_summary: The frozen input-independent three-body flip convolution commutes with complement, so the operational statistic remains zero.
failure_condition: Not blind if the higher-order channel contains a complement-breaking component.

derivation_summary: A zero-cost symmetry statistic can reflect drift only when drift changes the checked sector during target acquisition.
failure_condition: Blind to symmetry-preserving drift and cannot attribute temporal cause without repetition.
